description: PAID ($0.002 USDC via x402, paid automatically). Name, symbol, decimals and total supply for any ERC-20 contract on Base — the identity fields an agent needs before pricing or safety-checking a token. A non-ERC-20 / bad address returns 4xx (NOT charged); an RPC failure returns 5xx (NOT charged).

payment.description: Base64 of a single x402 v2 PaymentPayload you signed yourself. OPTIONAL: with AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY set, this tool pays automatically and you never need it. Use it to pay from a DIFFERENT wallet, or when no key is configured — call once without it to get the 402 (its body carries `howToPay.payloadTemplate`, the exact envelope to sign), then call again with it. When set it is sent as-is as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header; no local signing and no price ceiling are applied.

token.description: An ERC-20 contract address (0x…, 40 hex) on Base

name: token_metadata

name.description: Token name (null if the contract omits name())

symbol.description: Token symbol (null if the contract omits symbol())

totalSupply.description: Total supply as a decimal string (null if unavailable)

totalSupplyAtomic.description: Total supply in atomic units (string; null if unavailable)

title: ERC-20 token metadata on Base ($0.002)
